commit_message:
fix: cap backoff delay at max_ms

Long outages produced multi-hour sleeps. Clamp the delay and add tests.
summary: One-line production fix (clamp delay to max_ms) plus two new tests. cargo-mutants has nothing useful to mutate on the fixed line.

defects.description: `respects_max_delay` only checks attempts 0..4 (max 800 ms against a 10 s cap), so it never reaches the cap and passes on the pre-fix code; removing `.min(self.max_ms)` survives. The regression test must use an attempt whose uncapped delay exceeds max_ms (e.g. attempt 10 -> 102.4 s) and assert_eq! the delay equals max().
`delay_grows_with_attempts` only asserts delay(3) > delay(2), so a wrong factor or exponent (e.g. factor+1, attempt+1) passes. It should pin exact values such as 100, 200, 400, 800 ms.
